items.name: VSDAT
items.question: What was the date of the measurement?
items.crfCompletionInstructions: Record date of measurements using this format (DD-MON-YYYY).
items.definition: The date of the vital signs measurement, represented in an unambiguous date format (e.g., DD-MON-YYYY).

items.name: SYSBP_VSLOC

items.name: WBC_LBCAT
items.question: What was the name of the lab panel?
items.crfCompletionInstructions: Record the lab test category, if not preprinted on the CRF.
items.definition: A grouping of topic-variable values based on user-defined characteristics.
items.implementationNotes: Sponsor-defined controlled terminology. This would most commonly be either a heading or a preprinted category value on the CRF, and not a question to which the site would provide an answer. If a question is asked, the response would typically be a sponsor-defined codelist. If the form is laid out as a grid, then words such as "Category" can be included as the column heading. Laboratory tests have commonly recognized categories and subcategories that should be used whenever appropriate. LBCAT and or LBSCAT should be included if lab status (NOT DONE) is collected for each lab category (e.g., HEMATOLOGY, CHEMISTRY, URINALYSIS).
items.mappingInstructions: Maps directly to the SDTMIG variable listed in the SDTMIG Target column.

items.name: WBC_LBSCAT

items.implementationNotes: Sponsor-defined controlled terminology. This would most commonly be either a heading or a preprinted category value on the CRF, and not a question to which the site would provide an answer. If a question is asked, the response would typically be a sponsor-defined codelist. If the form is laid out as a grid, then words such as "Subcategory" can be included as the column heading. Laboratory tests have commonly recognized categories and subcategories that should be used whenever appropriate. LBSCAT can only be used if there is an LBCAT, and it must be a subcategorization of LBCAT.
items.mappingInstructions: Maps directly to the SDTMIG variable listed in the SDTMIG Target column.
